notes.title: T2.0.10 Demo Update
notes.content:
[p]NEW CONTENT[/p][list][*][p]Hero Draft Mode is now available! Room hosts can select this mode in the room-settings panel before the match begins.[/p][/*][/list][p]BUG FIXES[/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the item “Saddle” would not display values higher than 6.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved a bug that caused UI widgets to scale up abnormally.[/p][/*][*][p]“Freeze”-type effects now trigger correctly under all conditions.[/p][/*][*][p]Eliminated a soft-lock that occurred when another player rolled dice during a showdown.[/p][/*][*][p]Turn progression will no longer begin before all pending effects have finished resolving.[/p][/*][*][p]Skin presets will no longer automatically revert to Preset 1.[/p][/*][*][p]Afternoon Tea now properly prevents the target player from acting.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an exploit that allowed the hero Wiz to pull back a player standing in front of him.[/p][/*][*][p]Lava Core can no longer be used an unlimited number of times.[/p][/*][/list][p]BALANCE & TEXT UPDATES[/p][list][*][p]Updated the tooltip for the “Hide” skill.
– If you are hidden on another player when a duel triggers, you still choose the duel target; however, the duel’s effects are swapped between you and the target.
– Non-targeted and targetless effects are no longer exchanged.[/p][/*][/list]
